query: SELECT character.name, character.description, character.background, character.motive,                     character.ambition, location.id AS location_id, location.name AS location,                     location.description AS location_description, character_group.group_id              FROM character              JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = character.id              JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id              JOIN location ON location.id = "group".location_id              WHERE character.id = ? AND character.role = 'npc'
